summary: End-to-end testing of the new Site Visit Inspection module + engineer RBAC. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass (templates CRUD, site-visit CRUD, photo upload + static /api/uploads retrieval, auth PDF, public-token PDF without auth, engineer role POST/PUT, engineer mine=true filter). Frontend: admin can navigate to /site-visits, /site-visits/new, pick 'Beam Inspection' template -> 7-item checklist auto-loads with Yes/No/N/A toggles + remark fields, signature pad with Clear button, photo upload card present, Submit & Generate PDF button present. Settings page shows 'Site Visit Checklist Templates' card with all 5 seeded templates (Column/Slab/Beam/Foundation/Waterproofing) and engineer role option in the User Management role dropdown. Engineer login lands on /site-visits, navbar only exposes nav-projects and nav-site-visits, and /audits, /documents, /clients, /architects all correctly redirect engineer to /site-visits. ONE security bug found: engineer can reach /settings (route guard missing).

ui_bugs.issue: Inspection Title input is missing data-testid='input-inspection-title' (selector resolves to no element). Title still works because template selection auto-populates it, but the field is not test-addressable.

Native <option> elements contain Emergent-injected <span> wrappers which cause a React hydration warning ('<span> cannot be a child of <option>') and break Playwright's locator.select_option(label=...). This is Emergent tooling injection but it makes the select non-deterministic for automated tests; programmatic .value + change event works as a workaround.

integration_issues.issue: When logged in as an engineer, GET /settings is NOT redirected — the engineer can navigate to and view the Settings page (User Management, Backup, Document Number Series, Site Visit Templates, Data Management). All other restricted routes (/audits, /documents, /clients, /architects) correctly redirect to /site-visits, so this is an isolated route-guard miss for /settings. This is a privilege-escalation risk (engineer could see other users, change document number series, run backup, etc.).
affected_selectors: /settings route in App.js role-aware routing @ L30-87

action_items: FIX (HIGH): App.js role-aware routing — add a guard that redirects role==='engineer' away from /settings (mirror the redirect used for /audits, /documents, /clients, /architects).
ADD data-testid='input-inspection-title' to the Inspection Title <input> in SiteVisitFormPage.jsx for stable UI testing.

(Pre-existing, not strictly E1 scope) The <option><span> Emergent tag wrappers cause a React hydration warning and prevent label-based select_option. Either suppress tag wrapping inside <option> or convert the template select to a shadcn Select.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend (server.py): SiteVisit endpoints, public PDF route, and /api/uploads static mount work end-to-end exactly as specced. visit_code SV-XXXX generation and public_token (~unguessable) are correctly produced.

Backend (auth.py L293, L327): 'engineer' is properly accepted on both POST /api/auth/users and PUT /api/auth/users/{id}. PUT response is {'ok': true} (no user echo); UI may want to refetch user list after role change.
Frontend: Beam template auto-loads 7 items correctly; Foundation 7; Waterproofing 6; Column 8; Slab 8 — matches default seed.
Engineer side-nav correctly hides projects management actions and only exposes Projects + Site Visits per spec.
RBAC route guard for /settings is missing for engineer role — only nav is hidden but route is reachable by direct URL.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Public PDF route /api/site-visits/public/{token}/pdf works without Authorization header (verified) and 404s for invalid tokens. /api/uploads/site-visits/<file> static mount works without auth. Engineer role is fully wired in backend but App.js needs a /settings redirect for engineers. test_engineer user is left in place for next iteration (password: EngTest123!).
rca of the issue: The /settings route in App.js role-aware routing block (L30-87 per request) only checks for admin/staff vs engineer for the documents/audits/clients/architects routes; /settings is not included in the engineer-blocked list, so React Router renders the SettingsPage for any authenticated user. Mitigation: add `role !== 'engineer'` guard (or `role === 'admin'` requirement) around the /settings route element, and the route should redirect engineer requests to /site-visits.
